page.content:
Science officer and secret android serving the Company.

How Ash connects

  • Faction: Nostromo crew — Ash serves as the Nostromo's science officer.
  • Faction: Weyland-Yutani — Ash secretly serves Weyland-Yutani over the crew.

What is Ash?
